metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure session-lifecycle from .claude/orrery/plan.json; every edge is inferred from call sites. # Round 1 applies the accuracy, flow and conventions reviews: endSession alone exits demo and # logs out, an identity change only clears session data, /me refreshes once on a 401, and the # 401 interceptor has its no branch and its no-refresh-token exit. # Restructure: the 401 round trip (got401, refresh, rotate, retry and their three exits to # endSession) moved to token-refresh.yaml; this figure keeps startup, sign-out and identity change. title: Session startup, sign-out and identity change in the SPA subtitle: A stored token is verified with /api/auth/me, an identity change clears session data, and every sign-out goes through endSession kind: flowchart direction: down groups: lane-spa: { type: lane, label: SPA, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:12-67" } lane-be: { type: lane, label: Backend, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:24" } nodes: boot: shape: terminator label: App loads in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/App.tsx:201-203" # useAuthInit has-token: shape: decision label: Stored access token? in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:64-68" me: shape: data label: GET /api/auth/me note: a 401 refreshes once first in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:72", "frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:112", "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:327-339"] verify: shape: process label: Verify token, load user in: lane-be evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:59-62" me-ok: shape: decision label: Profile verified? in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:71-81" prefetch: shape: process label: Prefetch core data note: "preferences, recurring, Data Health" in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:76", "frontend/src/lib/prefetch.ts:15-33"] active: shape: process label: Serve authenticated requests note: a 401 runs the token refresh figure in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:74-77", "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:322-332"] identity: shape: decision label: Identity changed? note: auth store subscription in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:57-67" clear: shape: predefined label: clearSessionData note: "abort, new generation, clear caches, reset stores" in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:31-48" logout: shape: data label: POST /api/auth/logout note: "this device's push alerts stop first" in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:121-128", "frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:122#forgetThisDevice", "frontend/src/services/api/pushDevice.ts:183#forgetThisDevice", "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:26-40"] revoke: shape: process label: Bump token_version in: lane-be evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:65-74", "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_service.py:197-206"] end: shape: predefined label: endSession note: "clearSessionData, exit demo, log out store" in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:50-54" signedout: shape: terminator label: Signed out in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:52-53" edges: - boot -> has-token: { evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:64" } - has-token -> me: { label: "yes", evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:70-72" } - has-token -> end: { label: "no", evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:65-67" } - me -> verify: { evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:59-62" } - verify -> me-ok: { label: profile or 401, evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:73" } - me-ok -> prefetch: { label: "yes", evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:74-76" } - me-ok -> end: { label: "no", evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:78-79" } - prefetch -> active: { evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:77" } - active -> identity: { label: auth store changes, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:65" } - identity -> clear: { label: "yes", evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:66" } - identity -> active: { label: "no", evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:66" } - clear -> active: { label: new identity continues, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:65-67" } - active -> logout: { label: user signs out, evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:30-35" } - logout -> revoke: { evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:73" } - revoke -> end: { label: on settle or error, evidence: ["frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:37-38", "frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:123-127"] } - end -> signedout: { evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:50-54" }

svg.title: Session startup, sign-out and identity change in the SPA
svg.desc: Session startup, sign-out and identity change in the SPA. 13 components in 2 groups. Connections: App loads to Stored access token?; Stored access token? to GET /api/auth/me (yes); Stored access token? to endSession (no); GET /api/auth/me to Verify token, load user; Verify token, load user to Profile verified? (profile or 401); Profile verified? to Prefetch core data (yes); Profile verified? to endSession (no); Prefetch core data to Serve authenticated requests; Serve authenticated requests to Identity changed? (auth store changes); Identity changed? to clearSessionData (yes); Identity changed? to Serve authenticated requests (no); clearSessionData to Serve authenticated requests (new identity continues); Serve authenticated requests to POST /api/auth/logout (user signs out); POST /api/auth/logout to Bump token_version; Bump token_version to endSession (on settle or error); endSession to Signed out.

text.tspan: SESSION STARTUP, SIGN-OUT AND IDENTITY CHANGE IN THE SPA
A stored token is verified with /api/auth/me, an identity change clears session data, and every sign-out goes through
